bins.label: Systemic Collapse
bins.definition: An economic, environmental, or social catastrophe destabilises a civilization's existing order.

bins.label: Assassination Or Attempt
bins.definition: A targeted killing or political assassination alters historical trajectory.

bins.label: Regime Overthrow
bins.definition: A governing power or alliance falls to conquerors or internal transformation.

bins.label: Succession Struggle
bins.definition: The death or incapacitation of a leader triggers a fight for power.

bins.label: Emergence Of Vigilantes
bins.definition: Costumed or extralegal individuals emerge outside normal civil authority.

bins.label: Transhuman Breakthrough
bins.definition: A sapient being transcends normal mortal or physical biological limits.

bins.label: Decisive Military Victory
bins.definition: An armed conflict ends swiftly through overwhelming strategic force.

bins.label: Institutional Proscription
bins.definition: The state passes laws outlawing or suppressing a faction or practice.

bins.label: Catastrophic Mass Destruction
bins.definition: A sudden mass-casualty disaster strikes a major population center.

bins.label: Authoritarian Consolidation
bins.definition: A leader or faction legally dismantles democratic checks to secure dictatorship.

bins.label: Interminable Insurgency
bins.definition: A protracted asymmetric conflict grinds on without decisive resolution.

bins.label: Technological Watershed
bins.definition: The invention or first test of a transformative technological capability.

bins.label: Temporal Incursion
bins.definition: Agents or entities travel through time, intruding on a historical era.

bins.label: Destined Birth
bins.definition: A figure prophesied or destined to lead a faction is born.

bins.label: First Contact
bins.definition: Humanity or a civilization makes initial formal contact with extraterrestrial life.

bins.label: Interstellar Colonization
bins.definition: A civilization plants its first or major settlement beyond its home system.

bins.label: Deep Space Expedition
bins.definition: A pioneering crew embarks on extended exploratory travel into uncharted space.

bins.label: Interstellar Confederation
bins.definition: Multiple distinct sovereign species or worlds unite under a single charter.

_comment: The bin vocabulary. A bin is a KIND OF MOMENT that recurs across worlds; an event points at one by id. Bins are not fixed in advance - tools/bin-events.py adds to an existing bin when an event is like one already there, and creates a new bin only when nothing fits. This file is the outcome of that, and the thing to edit when you disagree with it.
